value.summary: This change converts the host loop from single-turn to concurrent-round processing: `HiveStep::Speak` now carries a vector of turns plus a single `next_state`, and the host commits state only after every turn in the round is durably journaled. The per-turn pinboard read is now bounded at `turn.round_start` to prevent leaking concurrently-laid pins, which is a security improvement. The mid-round failure-cap path returns early without committing `state` or incrementing `turns`, which is consistent with the round-level commit contract (a partial round must not charge the budget). The change looks safe to merge.
